title: Musculoskeletal system, skin and connective tissue
audience: a medical student in the preclinical years
purpose: Integrate bone and joint biology, fractures and injuries, osteoarthritis and back pain, inflammatory arthritis, crystal disease, lupus, vasculitis and connective tissue disease, metabolic bone disease, bone tumors and infection, skin structure and lesions, skin disease, infection and cancer.

weeks.6: Lupus, vasculitis and connective tissue disease
weeks.8: Bone and soft-tissue tumors and infections

blocks.deliverable: Describe a fracture and its urgent complications.
List red flags for back pain.
Week 7 midterm; compare osteoporosis and osteomalacia.
Describe ten lesions in standard terms.
Apply the ABCDE features of melanoma.
Submit the project; take an unseen 150 minute final in week 14.

project: Joint and skin workshop: describe ten supplied skin lesions and interpret five joint aspirate results, giving the likely diagnosis and first steps for each.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
